message.content:
**Screen Identity:** This is the **Home/Dashboard screen** of the **POSEART** app—a pose reference tool for artists. It serves as the main landing page after login, designed to help users quickly start a drawing session or browse pose categories. --- ### Main Content Breakdown (Top to Bottom): | Section | Content | Grid Location | |---------|--------|---------------| | **Header** | Time (4:39), App title "POSEART" | A1–P1 | | **Greeting** | "Good day, Artist." + subtitle "Ready to strike a new pose?" | B2–O3 | | **Featured Card** | Large teal gradient card with:
• Thumbnail of figure at table
• Label: "FEATURED POSE"
• Title: "Table Elbow Single"
• CTA button: "Start Session" (gold) | B4–O7 | | **Section Header** | "Browse Categories" | B8–H9 | | **Category Grid** | 2-column grid of 10 category cards (5 rows):
1. Standing (47 poses) – Dark green
2. Seated (86 poses) – Teal
3. Leaning—Standing (49 poses) – Blue
4. Leaning—Seated (30 poses) – Light blue
5. Kneeling (32 poses) – Gold/ochre
6. Reclining (56 poses) – Yellow-gold
7. Dynamic (30 poses) – Purple
8. Eccentric (44 poses) – Deep purple
9. [Partially visible] – Orange/terracotta
10. [Partially visible] – Green | B10–O16 | | **FAB** | Floating Action Button (+) for adding/custom content | N14–P15 | | **Bottom Navigation** | 5 tabs: Home (active), Poses, Gallery (centered, elevated), Progress, Profile | A17–P17 | --- ### Visible Defects & Observations: 1. **Truncation/Cutoff**: The bottom two category cards (row 5) are partially cut off by the navigation bar, suggesting the scrollable area doesn't account for the fixed bottom nav height. 2. **Floating Button Overlap**: The FAB (+) overlaps the bottom-right category card ("Eccentric"), potentially obscuring content or creating a touch target conflict. 3. **Inconsistent Typography**: The em-dash usage in category names is inconsistent—**"Leaning — Standing"** uses spaces around the dash while **"Leaning—Seated"** does not. 4. **Color Contrast**: The white text on the gold/yellow category cards (Kneeling, Reclining) may fail WCAG AA contrast guidelines for readability. **Grid Coordinates Summary:** Content spans approximately **A1–P17**, with the main interactive area occupying **B4–O16** and navigation anchored at **A17–P17**.
